items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the latest security updates as soon as possible.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical (Remote Code Execution)
items.summary: Sansec reported that Amasty released a massive security update for 25 Magento extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: This denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce stems from a vulnerable third-party component and can be triggered remotely without authentication or user interaction. Successful exploitation causes the application to crash, disrupting storefront and administrative availability.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store. The attack uses a polyglot to bypass validation, and Sansec has observed attacks on 79.5% of all stores.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Privilege Escalation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability addressed in APSB26-05 that could lead to privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce.
